d:
A recent spate of sexually driven murders have occurred in various towns around the country. The victims are young and attractive females who ended up dead and violated in deserted alleys a distance away from where they are supposed to be at. Police had no clues initially but much later on found out that the killer was able to hack the GPS system on the victims' phones and direct them to the alleys where they would be knocked unconscious, strangled then violated. By the time the police sent out warnings, many innocent young women have already become victims of the the GPS Killer.

Victim #5 was Wenxin, 22 year old college student on the way to collect a custom made action figure from a home bases sculptor for her boyfriend's birthday the next day. She was led into a dark alley and knocked out by the GPS Killer before suffering the same fate as the previous 4 victims.
